text:
Historical findings CASEID FILE NOTE
1) Domain context: A records office logs routine documents, validates signatures and dates, and retains filed forms for reference.

2) What occurred: The actor created a waste disposal form with an unverified manifest number field. The actor entered a destination location on a transport record without a licensed processor sign-off. The actor altered a date field on a shipment log without a time-stamp verification. The actor submitted a disposal certificate lacking a regulatory authority seal. The actor recorded a collection event on an access log without an inspector presence confirmation.

3) Materials/access observed: The actor used a shared administrative account. The actor accessed the document management system. The actor modified two filed records. The actor referenced a location map.

4) Indicators & artifacts: A manifest number with no corresponding processor registration. A destination field containing an unregistered site identifier. A date modification without an audit trail entry. A certificate field containing an invalid authority seal value. An access log entry without a matching inspector badge record.
